name: Content, with footnotes
description: Paragraphs with numbered footnote links that jump to a notes list and back again.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Title
fields.default: Why short clips persuade better than long reports

default.text: People remember stories far better than statistics, and a customer describing their own frustration is a story in its smallest form.
default.note: Our own test: colleagues recalled 71% of clip content a week later, against 23% of written findings.

default.text: Length matters too. Across 4,000 shared clips, the ones under thirty seconds were watched to the end almost every time.
default.note: Fieldnote usage data, January to June 2026, across 1,200 workspaces.

default.text: None of this makes written analysis less important. It changes its job: from carrying the evidence to pointing at it.
